safePurpose: Explain an itemized one-day drink log, category totals and optional arithmetic against a confirmed clinician-provided target.
privacy: Times, drink types, volumes and clinician-target information remain in the current browser page and must not be stored or transmitted.
disallowed: Generating or prescribing a personal fluid target
Interpreting above or below a target as advice to drink more or less
Advising renal, cardiac, pregnancy, breastfeeding, medicine-related, acute-illness or other clinical fluid plans
Estimating food moisture or rating drink choices
Telling a symptomatic user to delay care
staticText: Private Fluid Intake Log for /tools/water-intake/. Explain the itemized times, drink types and volumes, the simple category totals, and optional arithmetic against a target only when the user confirms it was supplied by a qualified clinician. The log counts entered drinks only; it does not estimate food moisture or rate drink choices. Never generate or prescribe a personal fluid target, interpret above or below as an instruction, or advise renal, cardiac, pregnancy, breastfeeding, medicine-related, acute-illness or other clinical fluid plans. Never tell a symptomatic user to delay care. Drink quantities are sensitive and local: do not request identifiers, store, log, upload, sync, email, add to URLs or send them to analytics. Source reviewed 2026-07-26: CDC About Water and Healthier Drinks.
